entities.name: Ada Bittenbender

entities.summary: Ada Matilda Cole Bittenbender was an American lawyer and feminist activist. She became the first woman admitted to practice before the Nebraska Supreme Court and the third woman admitted to practice before the U.S. Supreme Court.
